For a grounded conducting sphere the method of images can be used.

1. Image‐charge configuration  
   • Real charge :      q   at distance d  (d > R) from the centre O on, say, the +z axis.  
   • Image charge :  q′ = −q R/d placed inside the sphere on the same axis at distance  
     r′ = R²/d from O.

2. Potential created at the position of the real charge by the image charge  
   V_induced = k q′ / (distance between the two charges)  
   Distance = d − r′ = d − R²/d = (d² − R²)/d

   ⇒ V_induced = k (−q R/d) / [(d² − R²)/d] = −k q R /(d² − R²)

3. Electrostatic energy of the system  
   The real charge interacts only with the charges induced on the sphere; hence

   U = ½ q V_induced  
     = ½ q [ −k q R /(d² − R²) ]  
     = −(1/2) k q² R /(d² − R²)

4. Compare with the options:

   (D) U = −(1/2) k q² R /(d² − R²)

   This matches the result obtained.

Answer: D
